artworks.title: The Madonna and Child in a Garden
artworks.medium: engraving in white on laid paper prepared with black ink
artworks.dimensions:
plate (diameter): 10.6 cm (4 3/16 in.)
sheet (diameter): 10.8 cm (4 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated individual, depicted in a classical or antique style, with their figure visible from the knees upward. The person is positioned in a seated pose, holding an infant child. The figure’s facial features appear serene, with wavy, flowing hair cascading down their shoulders. They wear a draping robe or gown, detailed with folds and textures. A crown is visible around their head. The background includes architectural elements and decorative foliage or plant life. The artwork is rendered in a monochromatic style, emphasizing form and composition.

artworks.title: A Poet Reading
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 13.3 x 9 cm (5 1/4 x 3 9/16 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 39.4 x 31.8 cm (15 1/2 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: Printed with fine black lines on cream-white paper, a man wearing a knee-length tunic and reading from a piece of unfolded paper faces our right against a mostly blank background in this vertical engraving. The man's right shoulder, closer to us, is angled in a way that suggests his torso is turned slightly away from us even though his feet and face are shown in profile. A narrow wreath is almost lost in his dense curls, and he has a straight nose and prominent chin. His fur-lined tunic is belted low across his hips, and a dagger hangs from his belt. His pointed clog-like shoes seem to slip onto his feet like sandals, and he stands on a grassy field in an otherwise empty space. Creases in the paper he holds suggests it had been folded into nine sections.

artworks.title: The Wissahickon Creek near Philadelphia
artworks.description: The image shows a stream surrounded by dense woods. A fallen tree trunk crosses the stream, with a man seated on a chair nearby. Trees frame the scene, and the overall color palette is earthy with browns and greens blending into the background.

artworks.title: Merchants' Exchange, Philadelphia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harvey S. Shipley Miller and J. Randall Plummer
artworks.description: This is a neoclassical building with a dome and columns. The image shows a structure with a circular, colonnaded portico leading up to a dome, known as a rotunda, with a cupola on top. The building features rectangular windows between columns, likely Doric or Ionic. The architecture hints at a governmental building, possibly a bank or courthouse, exemplifying 19th-century neoclassical architecture. The photograph captures details such as stone steps leading up to entrances, the texture of the stone, and some furniture visible on the exterior. The sepia tones suggest an old photograph.

artworks.title: Park
artworks.medium: color lithographic facsimile on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Alexander Pope
artworks.description: The painting displays a stylized landscape with abstract tree-like shapes and blocks of color suggesting a receding land scene. Three prominent tree shapes rise upwards in the composition, placed somewhat centrally. The brushstrokes have a blocky, almost collage-like quality, using broad splashes of color and texture to form foliage and land. The color palette is rich and earthy, with various shades of green, dark browns, maroon, lighter greens, ochres, and muted red. The piece conveys a sense of layered textures and tones in nature without providing intricate details.

artworks.title: Peasant
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting on the ground, seen in profile with her full body visible. She is seated on a bundle of straw, with her knees bent and arms resting on them while holding an object. Her head is turned slightly downward, with her hair covered by a headscarf, leaving only part of her face visible. She is dressed in a long-sleeved shirt, a dark sleeveless dress or apron, a long skirt, and an apron over her lap. The background shows grass on the ground and dense foliage or vines against a wall, suggesting an outdoor setting. The image is in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Nude
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length view of a nude person standing on their toes against a wall. The person's arms are raised above their head, hands touching the wall, with their right knee slightly bent. Their head is tilted back slightly, with their face partially visible and displaying smooth facial features and a calm expression. The person has short hair falling softly around their head and is holding a piece of drapery that cascades behind them. The surroundings are slightly out of focus, with upholstery or drapery gathered on the floor to the right and a suggestion of furniture in the foreground. The background is a textured wall that fades into shadow towards the edges, adding to the composition's soft, atmospheric quality.

artworks.title: Hermann Struck in Uniform
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man in profile view from the waist up. The man has a mustache and darker hair, and is wearing a uniform with epaulets. The background is created with a wash of pale colors. The man is seated on a chair, and no specific objects or jewelry are visible.

artworks.title: Cheveaux des Ardennes
artworks.description: The image shows a man in military attire seated on a horse harnessed to a two-wheeled cart. The man is upright with a serious expression, wearing a military hat and a decorated coat. The cart is simple, and the horses are adorned with harnesses. The background is minimal, with the words "Chevaux Ardennois" inscribed below.

artworks.title: Cheval de Mecklembourg
artworks.description: This is an image of a horse in front of a stable. The horse is adorned with harnesses. In the background is a stable with large wooden doors and a small window above. The setting seems rustic, possibly on a farm or countryside stable. The scene is detailed, with attention given to the texture of the horse's coat and the brickwork of the stable. There is an aura of motion and interaction in the image.

artworks.title: Cheval de la plaine de Caen
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved depiction of a horse in profile view, standing with its head turned slightly to the left. A person is engaging with another individual. The horse is covered with a striped blanket. Two men are talking near an archway, dressed in period attire. One man wears a brimmed hat. In the background, two more figures are partially visible near an arch structure. The scene is set inside a stone-walled space, possibly a stable or courtyard, with shadows and textured surfaces adding depth to the image.

artworks.title: Horse Jumping a Barrier
artworks.description: The image shows a horse jumping over a fence. The horse is depicted in mid-air over a wooden gate or fence. The background is plain, with shading suggesting the ground and shadows. The lines and shadows are finely executed, emphasizing movement and strength. The drawing highlights the elegance and power of the horse in motion.

artworks.title: British Horse and Jockey
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a horse. The person is turned slightly to their left side, hand resting on the horse. The person's face is obscured by a helmet shadow. They wear typical equestrian attire. The horse has a decorative cloth on its saddle. The background is a minimalist landscape with a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Leçon de Voltiges (Trick Riding)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic horse race scene featuring several horses and riders in exaggerated poses. The illustration depicts riders in different riding stages and falling off their horses. Each horse and rider has a sign or banner with text. The composition shows a balanced layout with dynamic movement and a lively atmosphere. Detailed lines capture expressive facial expressions and exaggerated horse gaits.

artworks.title: File...Moello! Vla le municipal!
artworks.description: This image depicts a beach scene with people running while holding clothing and shoes, with several onlookers in the background. Two figures are shown in motion carrying their belongings as they sprint across a sandy beach. In the background, there is a structure with a sign reading "Bains d'Hommes à 4 Sous." Observers are seen with hats and umbrellas, observing the runners. The drawing captures a sense of urgency and humor, with caricature-like poses of the figures in motion. Additional figures in the background contribute to the bustling atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Fausse position!!!
artworks.description: The image shows people swimming in an indoor pool. It depicts individuals in a wooden enclosed pool or bathhouse. The setting is a confined wooden space filled with water. The focus is on a person who is jumping or falling into the water, expressing surprise or alarm. Another person is partially submerged, floating on their back with a shocked expression. Their legs are lifted out of the water in an awkward manner, adding a humorous tone. The drawing uses a monochrome palette and lines to highlight expressions and motion in the scene.

artworks.title: Tiens c't'idée! Le municipal qui boit un coup...
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in the foreground. The figure on the left is leaning back, shirtless, wearing knee-length shorts, with disheveled hair. He has a surprised expression. On the right, the second figure is partially submerged in water, lying on his back with kicking legs. He wears long pants and a dark jacket, with curly hair. His left arm is raised above the water. In the background, smaller figures are in motion or seated near a body of water with stone or wooden structures. The setting has a sketched backdrop with simplistic outlines of structures and distant figures.

artworks.title: Nayades de la Seine (Sea Nymphs of the Seine)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several individuals in water, with more figures in the background on a platform. The composition features the heads and torsos of six figures bobbing in the rippling water, each wearing a swim cap or bonnet. Their expressions range from serene to focused. Above the swimmers, there is a dock or platform where more figures are depicted in varied poses, suggesting activity. The background is detailed with suggestion of architecture or a barrier. This is a monochrome piece, likely using charcoal or pencil, as indicated by the soft shading and fine line work.

artworks.title: A la recherche d'une forêt en Champagne (In Search of a Forest in Champagne)
artworks.description: The image shows two men walking in profile from left to right. Both men are bending slightly forward as they walk. The man on the left has a beard, a wide-brimmed hat, and a plaid outfit. He is holding a staff. The man on the right is wearing a similar wide-brimmed hat, a long coat, and checkered pants. He is holding an artist's portfolio and a stick. Both men have packs on their backs. The background shows a barren, rocky landscape with sparse trees in the distance under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Pas engageant pour les autres (Unenticing for the Others)
artworks.medium: lithograph with watercolor (added by a later hand) on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three rats gathered around a trap. The drawing shows three rats labeled "HESSE," "HANOVRE," and "SAXE" in front of a large, box-shaped trap set in a barren landscape with several other rats approaching in the background. The trap is depicted with metal hoops and circular entrances. The coloring is soft, with shades of brown dominating the ground, and a pale blue sky overhead. This is in style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: The Templum Minerva Medica and the Surrounding Area
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Andrew Szegedy-Maszak and Elizabeth Bobrick in honor of Aladar and Hanna Szegedy-Maszak
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient, arched ruin partially covered with foliage. The ruin is in the middle of the scene and extends upwards, displaying aged arches and openings with some overgrown greenery. To the left of the ruin, there are two buildings - one with historical architecture and ornate detailing, and another plain building partially hidden behind foliage. The horizon is low in the image and mostly obscured by the central structure and the buildings to the left. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving the image a vintage feel and emphasizing textures. The scene balances man-made structure and nature.

artworks.title: Caricature with Mola Protecting Himself from a Man Holding a Viper
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael Miller and Lucy Vivante
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of two figures captured from the waist up. The person on the left is facing forward with curly hair cascading around their shoulders. Their facial features are roughly sketched, with prominent eyes and a subtle smile. They are wearing a garment with frilled or puffed sleeves and their hand is visible. The person on the right is in profile, facing left, with a more angular facial structure, including a prominent nose and chin. They have straight hair or a headpiece extending backward. Both figures are presented in a simplified, stylized manner without detailed clothing or accessories. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.artist: Abraham van Diepenbeeck after Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: pen and ink and oil paint over black chalk on brown paper, laid down on canvas
artworks.description: This is a painting of multiple people and horses in a tumultuous setting. There are armored men on horseback interacting with a man in the center who seems have fallen off a horse and on to the ground. The scene conveys movement and action, with contorted forms of both humans and animals. One horse rears into the air, while another leans forward with its back legs raised. At the top of the painting, a person with long hair emerges from the clouds. Rays of white light shine down from the opening in the clouds on to the people and horses.

artworks.title: The Death of Virginia
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray, yellow, and green washes on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a scene with classical architectural elements and labeled figures interacting. The composition includes architectural details like arches and columns, as well as decorative elements. The drawing also features stylized patterns with mythical creatures and ornamental designs. In the lower part, there is a reclining figure, ornamental designs, and an empty heraldic shield. The drawing is monochrome, using fine lines to show depth and form. The style resembles Renaissance woodcuts or engravings, focusing on allegorical and symbolic representation.
